endorsements.name: Ulises Gascón
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-13465
endorsements.description: The _.unset and _.omit functions in Lodash are vulnerable to prototype pollution. An attacker can pass crafted paths which cause Lodash to delete methods from global prototypes. The issue permits deletion of properties but does not allow overwriting their original behavior. The issue is patched from 4.17.23 to 4.18.0 depending on the package: lodash, lodash-es, and lodash-amd in 4.17.23, and the standalone lodash.unset and lodash.omit packages in 4.18.0.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)

endorsements.name: Ulises Gascón
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-13466
endorsements.description:
body-parser 2.2.0 is vulnerable to denial of service due to inefficient handling of URL-encoded bodies with very large numbers of parameters. An attacker can send payloads containing thousands of parameters within the default 100KB request size limit, causing elevated CPU and memory usage. This can lead to service slowdown or partial outages under sustained malicious traffic.
This issue is addressed in version 2.2.1.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.5)
